captions.caption: A forklift is moving a large generator toward the open back of a military helicopter.
The forklift continues to push the generator closer to the helicopter's loading ramp.
The forklift aligns the generator with the entrance of the helicopter's cargo hold.
The generator is partially inside the helicopter as the forklift pushes it further.
The forklift operator and ground crew coordinate as the generator enters the helicopter.
A close-up view shows the generator being secured inside the helicopter's hold.
Ground crew members inside the helicopter guide the generator into place.
The forklift backs away slightly as the generator is positioned.
Crew members use hand signals to guide the forklift operator.
The generator is almost fully loaded into the back of the helicopter.
The forklift forks are lowered once the generator is stable inside.
A crew member checks the labels on a large white crate inside the helicopter.
The crew member adjusts the position of the white crate.
Several crates are visible stacked inside the helicopter's cargo area.
A crew member prepares to secure the cargo with straps.
The view from inside the helicopter shows more crew members outside on the gravel.
Crew members move around the loaded crates inside the helicopter.
A soldier points toward the exterior from the open cargo ramp.
The crew finishes adjusting the straps on the heavy equipment.
A crew member walks away from the loaded generator inside the hold.
Close-up of a crew member kneeling to secure the generator to the helicopter floor.
The crew member tightens a strap on the side of the large generator.
Another crew member assists in securing the equipment inside the aircraft.
The camera focuses on the mechanical connection point of the forklift.
Crew members continue working near the back of the open helicopter.
A crew member stands on the ramp, watching the surroundings.
The forklift starts to reverse away from the helicopter's ramp.
The empty forks of the forklift are visible as it moves back.
The forklift turns on the rocky ground, moving away from the aircraft.
A view from the ground shows the forklift driving away into the distance.
The forklift continues across the dry, desert-like terrain.
Dust is kicked up as the forklift moves across the gravel.
The forklift heads toward other military vehicles parked nearby.
A wide shot shows the helicopter and the forklift in the arid landscape.
The forklift operator maneuvers the vehicle away from the landing zone.
The helicopter's rotors are spinning as the loading process concludes.
The forklift finishes its turn and drives further away.
A crew member walks toward the back of the helicopter.
Soldiers are gathered near the helicopter's open ramp.
The helicopter remains stationary with its ramp open on the gravel.
Soldiers carry gear and bags toward the entrance of the helicopter.
A group of soldiers prepares to board the aircraft.
Soldiers carry heavy black bags into the helicopter.
One soldier carries a long, tan equipment case toward the ramp.
More soldiers follow, carrying their personal gear and weapons.
The ground crew directs the soldiers into the cargo hold.
The last few soldiers enter the back of the large helicopter.
A large military helicopter sits on a dusty field with its rotors spinning.
The helicopter begins to lift slightly off the ground.
Dust is kicked up by the downwash of the helicopter's rotors.
The helicopter hovers a few feet above the rocky terrain.
Soldiers on the ground watch as the helicopter prepares for takeoff.
The helicopter maintains its hover position while ground crew members move away.
Two crew members are visible standing beneath the hovering helicopter.
The helicopter hovers steadily as it prepares to lift a load.
A sling load operation is underway as the helicopter hovers.
Crew members on the ground reach up toward the helicopter's belly.
The helicopter stays in a low hover over the ground crew.
Dust continues to swirl around the helicopter and the personnel below.
The helicopter remains in a steady hover, ready for the next phase of the mission.
